blind.description: A stylized wooden garden trellis panel. It consists of a sturdy rectangular timber frame with post caps and an internal diamond lattice backing, covered on the front side with thick green ivy foliage and blooming five-petaled red flowers with yellow centers. The rear shows the back of the carved wooden lattice and frame. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A horizontal wooden beam with square post caps on either end, flanked along the front edge by wavy green leaves and red floral petals extending outward.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 feet tall (roughly 85% of the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and approximately 3.3 feet wide.
